facts.label: Apresentação em ordem
facts.sub: Use I’m going to + verbo base com first, then e finally para organizar uma apresentação: First, I’m going to show the idea.

facts.label: Primeiro
facts.sub: Use First para começar o plano: First, I’m going to show the big idea. A vírgula depois de First ajuda na escrita. Na fala, faça uma pequena pausa.

facts.label: Depois
facts.sub: Use Then para o passo seguinte: Then I’m going to show three photos. Se tiver mais passos, repita then: Then I’m going to tell a story.

pages.title: A quiet office · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Thursday morning in a quiet office in Halifax. A big screen waits in the meeting room. Theo holds a small remote. His coworker Grace walks in. The presentation starts in ten minutes. Grace wants to know the plan.
“Hi, Theo! Are you ready for the presentation?” says Grace. “Almost! I’m going to talk about our new product.” says Theo. “Great. What are you going to say first?” says Grace.
